mechanism: SpaceXAI and Terafab's staged buildout increase near-term demand for externally fabricated Nvidia and custom silicon while internal logic, packaging and memory are unqualified; TSMC can monetize that bridge through leading-node wafers and advanced packaging, but successful Terafab internalization creates a long-run displacement risk.
catalyst: SpaceXAI or Tesla demand produces measurable TSMC-fabricated accelerator or custom-silicon volume, advanced-packaging demand expands during the Terafab ramp, or external sourcing persists after internal phases begin.
invalidation: SpaceXAI demand is immaterial or shifts away from TSMC-fabricated products; Terafab qualifies competitive leading-edge logic and packaging faster than expected; TSMC loses relevant Nvidia or custom-silicon designs; or incremental bridge revenue is outweighed by durable customer insourcing.
